newsitem.title: USA: BAB opens Big Apple airport stores.
newsitem.headline: BAB opens Big Apple airport stores.

text.p: BAB Holdings Inc said Monday it opened Big Apple Bagels retail stores at Orlando Airport, Las Vegas International Airport, Milwaukee International Airport, Vancouver International Airport and Detroit Metropolitan Airport.
The new stores will be operated by Host Marriott Services Corp, BAB said.

The company also said plans have been approved for a Big Apple location at the Jacksonville, Fla. Airport in September, as have plans for five additional bagel countertop outlets at Las Vegas International Airport.
BAB Holdings includes 250 units in 28 states and Canada.
